Regarding the installation process, `pip install prek` works well on my end.

This seems to cause a problem in Godot forks. A failure occurs whenever there is a large diff between the branch's previous state and the new state, resulting in an "Argument list too long" error. So essentially, if anyone has a Godot fork, and they just... don't sync their `master` branch for awhile, then they sync their `master` branch, `prek` explodes. For reference, see this CI run: https://github.com/godot-dimensions/godot/actions/runs/30243286140/job/89904801550 Also, another problem: When a brand new branch is created, the list of changed files is reported as nothing... so the checks completely skip everything, and a style problem would go unchecked until after the user submits that branch as a PR. EDIT: I submitted https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/121819 to fix it.
